title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1 te Kompleksi Aura ne Rr. Dritan Hoxha 171,105 €
description_sq:
Ne rrugen Dritan Hoxha, ne kompleks i cili ndodhet ne fazen e fundit te ndertimit me akses ne rrugen kryesore,
 shesim nje apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe 105.6 m2. 
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 1 te banimit, dhe ka nje organizim me 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 sallon pritje, 
1 tualet dhe ballkon. 
Kompleksi eshte ne fazen e fundit te ndertimit dhe per pak muaj dorezohet
. Ky apartament ka nje organizim shume te mire, kuadratik dhe eshte i mire ndricuar.
title_en: 2+1 Apartment for sale in the Aura Complex in St. Dritan Hoxha €171,105
description_en: On Dritan Hoxha street, in the complex which is in the last phase of construction with access to the main road, we sell a 2+1 apartment with an area of ​​105.6 m2. The apartment is located on the 1st floor of the residence, and has an arrangement with 2 bedrooms, 1 living room, 1 bathroom and a balcony. The complex is in the last phase of construction and will be delivered in a few months. This apartment has a very good organization, square and is well lit.
